mapper.sql: r.*, s.name AS store_name, w.name AS warehouse_name, ss.name AS supply_store_name, sw.name AS supply_warehouse_name, u.nickname AS create_by_name, au.nickname AS audit_by_name

LEFT JOIN store_info s ON s.id = r.store_id LEFT JOIN wms_warehouse w ON w.id = r.warehouse_id LEFT JOIN store_info ss ON ss.id = r.supply_store_id LEFT JOIN wms_warehouse sw ON sw.id = r.supply_warehouse_id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = r.create_by LEFT JOIN sys_user au ON au.id = r.audit_by
mapper.select: SELECT i.*, m.code AS material_code, m.name AS material_name, m.spec, m.unit, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(s.qty), 0) FROM wms_stock s WHERE s.warehouse_id = #{warehouseId} AND s.material_id = i.material_id) AS stock_qty, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(ti.qty), 0) FROM wms_stock_doc_item ti JOIN wms_stock_doc td ON td.id = ti.doc_id WHERE td.kind = 'TRANSFER' AND td.status = 'TRANSIT' AND td.to_warehouse_id = #{warehouseId} AND ti.material_id = i.material_id) AS transit_qty, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(s.qty - s.frozen_qty), 0) FROM wms_stock s WHERE s.warehouse_id = #{supplyWarehouseId} AND s.material_id = i.material_id) AS supply_available FROM dist_requisition_item i JOIN wms_material m ON m.id = i.material_id WHERE i.requisition_id = #{requisitionId} ORDER BY i.id
SELECT id FROM dist_requisition WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE

SELECT g.supply_warehouse_id, sw.name AS supply_warehouse_name, g.material_id, m.code AS material_code, m.name AS material_name, m.spec, m.unit, g.requisition_count, g.store_count, g.approved_qty, g.delivered_qty, g.pending_qty, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(s.qty - s.frozen_qty), 0) FROM wms_stock s WHERE s.warehouse_id = g.supply_warehouse_id AND s.material_id = g.material_id) AS available FROM (SELECT r.supply_warehouse_id, i.material_id, COUNT(DISTINCT r.id) AS requisition_count, COUNT(DISTINCT r.store_id) AS store_count, SUM(COALESCE(i.approved_qty, 0)) AS approved_qty, SUM(i.delivered_qty) AS delivered_qty, SUM(COALESCE(i.approved_qty, 0) - i.delivered_qty) AS pending_qty FROM dist_requisition r JOIN dist_requisition_item i ON i.requisition_id = r.id WHERE r.status IN ('APPROVED', 'PARTIAL') AND COALESCE(i.approved_qty, 0) > i.delivered_qty AND r.supply_warehouse_id = #{supplyWarehouseId} GROUP BY r.supply_warehouse_id, i.material_id) g JOIN wms_material m ON m.id = g.material_id LEFT JOIN wms_warehouse sw ON sw.id = g.supply_warehouse_id
(m.code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR m.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
ORDER BY g.supply_warehouse_id, m.code
